searchText: https://github.com/ethereum/execution-apis/pull/628 cc <@&688101493978562687> I dont think we have that yet + why should it be non-optional? +getBlobsV1 does not really necessairly decrease bandwidth nor allow for an increase in blob count (worst case stays the same) then this should be surfaced in blob discussions well, the PR articulates why (and the TOCTOU issues is real, it's really difficult to use optional endpoints in a reliable way except just trying them, which, ok, that's what Nimbus will do). But if it's not useful for blob count, not necessarily by you, just in general; right now I've repeatedly been told that, oh, it's fine because getBlobs. So is this documented somewhere? Not sure who told you but if your EL does not have well connected peers (worst case), it might not have blobs in the txpool and thus make it innefective + the public blob pool is empty nowadays so I am really unsure if there is any benefit for solo-staker or people not providing mevboost services What evidence is there that the public blob pool is empty? I know at least OP mainnet blobs are sent to the public mempool and I’ve not heard of any chain operator using private mempools to submit blobs. The data I have seen posted previously suggested the hit rate for blobs via getBlobsV1 was quite good and it did show reductions in bandwidth. If a validators node is not well connected they are not going to be effective regardless of blob count and need to fix that.
